name: attachment
title: Attachment
description: Displays a file or image attachment with media, metadata, state, and actions.

files.content:
---
import type { HTMLTag, Polymorphic } from "astro/types"

import { Button, type ButtonVariantProps } from "@/components/ui/button"

type Props<Tag extends HTMLTag = "button"> = Polymorphic<{ as: Tag }> &
  ButtonVariantProps

const { as, variant = "ghost", size = "icon-xs", ...props } = Astro.props
---

<Button
  as={as}
  data-slot="attachment-action"
  variant={variant}
  size={size}
  {...props}
>
  <slot />
</Button>
--- import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" type Props = HTMLAttributes<"div"> const { class: className, ...props } = Astro.props ---
